items.summary: Recommendation: preserve containment-only execution. No new production change_request is justified because the actionability scorecard has no unblocked candidates and active work already covers relevant sites. Evidence from the 30-day scorecard: 191 approved proposals lack execution, 46 failed-request repairs remain open, 25 deployed improvements await measurement, and only 1 outcome is proven. Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission and $0 site-attributed; ROI, margin, and causal lift are unknown. SearchWoot remains private. Owner decision: authorize sending the prepared Woot permission request, or keep it unsent.

Recommendation: continue the existing measurement work only. Use source-dated impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, site-attributed commission, and available AI cost; do not treat unavailable revenue or attribution as zero. Smallest next step: record the next scheduled observations for deployed improvements and compare measured deltas with their acceptance thresholds.

Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and continue internal evidence preparation only. Official Woot API access is documented, but public/commercial storage, derivatives, display, caching, alerts, and monetization rights remain unconfirmed; legal, security, accuracy, privacy, measurement, and owner gates are incomplete. Smallest next step: attach the consolidated read-only rights, data-flow, retention, consent, vendor, and incident evidence without sending outreach.
